name: Enchanted Ring
body:
Aura varies; CL varies; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The enchanted ring is a failed creation of any type of magic ring. As such, it radiates the same aura and has the same caster level of the ring which was intended to be created. Unlike the intended ring type, the enchanted ring has no functions nor abilities save to take up a ring slot for the wearer.

Once worn, the enchanted ring can only be removed by a remove curse, though the ring retains its magical nature.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items any magic ring

Identification DC varies
False Identification DC varies
